camel_example:
aliyun cloudapi CreatePlugin --region cn-hangzhou --PluginName NewCors --PluginData='---
unit: SECOND         
apiDefault: 1000     
userDefault: 30      
appDefault: 30     
specials:            
  - type: "APP"      
    policies:
    - key: 10123123  
      value: 10     
    - key: 10123123  
      value: 10' --PluginType cors
kebab_example:
aliyun cloudapi create-plugin --plugin-name NewCors --plugin-type cors --plugin-data='---
unit: SECOND         
apiDefault: 1000     
userDefault: 30      
appDefault: 30     
specials:            
  - type: "APP"      
    policies:
    - key: 10123123  
      value: 10     
    - key: 10123123  
      value: 10' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePlugin

parameters.help_en: The name of the plug-in. The name must be 4 to 50 characters in length and can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, and underscores (_). It cannot start with an underscore
parameters.help_zh: 插件名称。支持大小写英文字母、中文、数字、下划线（_）、长度为[4,50]个字符, 且不能以下划线开头
parameters.name: plugin_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the plug-in. Valid values:

ipControl: IP access control
trafficControl: throttling
backendSignature: backend signature
jwtAuth: JWT (OpenID Connect)
cors: CORS
caching: caching
basicAuth: Basic Auth
routing: backend routing
accessControl: parameter-based access control
errorMapping: error code mapping
circuitBreaker: circuit breaker (dedicated instances only)
remoteAuth: third-party authentication (dedicated instances only)
parameters.help_zh:
插件类型, 可选值：

ipControl：IP访问控制
trafficControl：流量控制
backendSignature：后端签名
jwtAuth：JWT(OpenId Connect)
cors：CORS跨域资源访问
caching：缓存
basicAuth: Basic Auth
routing：后端路由
accessControl：参数访问控制
errorMapping：错误码映射
circuitBreaker：断路器（仅专享实例）
remoteAuth：第三方鉴权（仅专享实例）
parameters.name: plugin_type

parameters.example:
---
unit: SECOND         
apiDefault: 1000     
userDefault: 30      
appDefault: 30     
specials:            
  - type: "APP"      
    policies:
    - key: 10123123  
      value: 10     
    - key: 10123123  
      value: 10
parameters.help_en: The plug-in definition statement. JSON and YAML formats are supported
parameters.name: plugin_data

parameters.help_en: The description of the plug-in. The description can be up to 200 characters in length
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en:
The tag key.

Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh:
标签键。

n 的取值范围为 `[1, 20]`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value.

Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh:
标签值。

n 的取值范围为 `[1, 20]`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags of the objects to which the rule applies. You can specify multiple tags
parameters.help_zh: 指定规则所适用的对象标签，可设置多个
parameters.name: tag

PluginId.description_en: The ID of the created plug-in

TagStatus.description_en: Indicates whether the plug-in is successfully tagged
